dev.paragraph1: From a young age, I’ve been fascinated by video games, driven by a desire to understand the mechanics and creativity behind immersive virtual worlds. This curiosity inspired me to explore the art and science of game development.
dev.paragraph2_part1: As this passion grew, it led to the creation of this
dev.paragraph2_highlight: indie horror game set within Sri Lanka.
dev.paragraph2_part2: After months of learning, development, and testing, I am proud to introduce this indie horror game
dev.paragraph3: This achievement marks only the beginning, with many more yet to come.
dev.name: Yasitha Dulaj
